name: CF RAT
description: ProCo RAT, port of Comet Flower's circuit model: exact gain legs, 100 pF feedback cap, LM308 slew and bandwidth limits, 1N914 shunt pair, Filter control.

params.name: Distortion
params.explanation: 100k log pot in the op-amp feedback; 0 = clean unity stage.

params.name: Filter
params.explanation: Tone low-pass, 475 Hz to 32 kHz; up = brighter (Comet Flower convention).
